brief.summary: Clever girl dressing turned up: a pleated mini or low-slung tailored skirt with a preppy knit or shrunken cardigan, a crisp shirt, ballet flats or loafers with socks, a collegiate jacket. Prettiness undercut by something wrong on purpose — a raw hem, a visible waistband, a too-short knit — and finished with a satin bag or a bow.
signatures: pleated or low-rise tailored mini skirt
shrunken cardigan or cropped preppy knit
crisp white shirt or polo with the collar out
satin ballet flat or chunky loafer with socks
sheer or lace slip layered over a tee
a bow, a brooch or a wide belt as the finish
silhouettes: mini skirt with a knit and flats
low waist with a cropped top
palette: a flash of silver or satin
